My journey into wellness and transformation is anchored in faith. I’ve walked through grief, watched illness unravel someone I loved, and made choices no woman ever expects to make. But through it all, I never walked alone. God was there, whispering, guiding, comforting, and sometimes carrying me when I had no strength left. I believe nothing in my life has been an accident, not even the night a tiny stray kitten chose our doorstep and helped restart our hearts.

That moment was the beginning of a new chapter; one where healing, love, and purpose found their way back in. I believe that health is sacred, that our bodies and souls are deeply connected, and that every person deserves to feel whole. My work today is a direct extension of that belief. I’m not just here to help people improve their health. I’m here to remind them that they’re not alone, that they’re seen, and that restoration is possible, no matter how far gone things may seem. And if you’re reading this… you’re not here by coincidence either.
Your body at full potential

paragraphs: Our Team is a collective of passionate change agents with a shared commitment to catalyzing personal and organizational transformation. Through our Integrated Leadership & Corporate Wellness (ILCW) program, we partner with visionary, like-minded organizations and professionals to help individuals, families, and communities thrive, starting within the workplace. We believe that organizations are powerful access points for lasting change, and our work is designed to elevate leadership, enhance well-being, and build resilient, purpose-driven cultures from the inside out.

To be the partner of choice across the Caribbean and Pan American region for Integrated Leadership and Immersive Holistic Corporate Wellness, delivering transformative programs that elevate people, performance, and purpose from the C-suite to the front line.
To serve as a trusted hub and catalyst for holistic well-being, resilient leadership, and collaborative growth, by designing and delivering tailored wellness experiences that:
empower individuals to reclaim their health, vitality, and voice.
enable teams to connect, trust, and thrive.
Invite every partner and contributor into a shared-value ecosystem where everyone wins.
Through this mission, we create a movement of wellness-centered leadership where inner alignment fuels outer impact.
Nicole Quan Kep is the founder of Power10HK and KEP-STAR, two Hong Kong–based enterprises that reflect her passion for connecting people, performance, and purpose across borders.

With over 25 years of international corporate experience and 15 years in athletic coaching and team management, Nicole has developed and advanced a distinctive approach to leadership and organizational wellness. At FDM Group—an award-winning global business and technology consultancy powering the people behind tech and innovation—she developed and advanced programs that enhance employee performance and growth, grounded in her coaching expertise and deep understanding of Customer Relationship Management (CRM). Her work helped elevate cultures of excellence, career progression, and employee well-being within the IT and Financial Services sectors.

Through Power10HK, Nicole integrates athletic training principles into corporate development strategies, creating transformative team-building experiences that drive connection, resilience, and measurable results.

As founder of KEP-STAR, she brings a Master’s Degree in Economics and Trade from Chongqing University and extensive experience in China sourcing and event management, enabling clients to access unparalleled networks and opportunities throughout Asia.

Nicole’s dual enterprises complement Francois Consulting Group’s Integrated Leadership & Corporate Wellness programs, amplifying their shared mission to foster high-performing, values-aligned teams and sustainable international growth.
Collaboration Over Competition
We believe in building bridges, not silos. Every partner, provider, and client contributes to a dynamic ecosystem of mutual benefit and collective success.
We see individuals as more than job titles. We design experiences that nurture the mind, body, spirit, and professional self.
We walk our talk, leading by example, making decisions aligned with our values, and holding space for honest conversations and accountable results.
Inclusion and Cultural Intelligence
We respect the diversity of the Caribbean and broader Pan-American landscape, and we aim to serve with empathy, equity, and cultural fluency.
We anticipate needs before they arise. By listening deeply and iterating boldly, we build programs and partnerships that evolve and endure.

Wendy Yawching is an accomplished leader, pioneering female aviator, and certified Master Feng Shui Consultant with a passion for personal and professional transformation. Wendy made history as the first female Captain of Trinidad and Tobago’s national airline, the first Trinidadian woman to reach Mt. With a 28-year aviation career, Wendy retired as a Captain with Caribbean Airlines and later founded Healing Spaces Caribbean, offering Feng Shui consultations, workshops, and motivational speaking. As Environmental Director for Tobago’s Yahweh Foundation, she launched an award-winning environmental program for students. Wendy’s accomplishments, including being named a ?Living Caribbean Legend? in 2023, reflect her leadership, dedication, and commitment to inspiring others. Troy Hadeed is an entrepreneur, author, yoga teacher, and social entrepreneur with over 20+ years of experience in the fields of mindfulness, emotional regulation, perspective-shifting and the ongoing exploration of the human condition. The first instant he stepped onto a corporate stage he realized how much of an impact we can have on social culture and wellbeing by shifting perspectives and cultures within the workplace. Human relationships are at the core of them both and if we can provide our workspaces with the tools to cultivate better relationships, not only will it increase workplace relations along with efficiency and profits, but also change the world.

Lisa Feveck is a dedicated dietitian, educator, author and transformation coach who is passionate about supporting women with their health issues, especially through midlife and menopause. She understands the unique cultural and personal challenges faced by Caribbean women during this phase and is on a mission to simplify healthy eating, making nutrition more approachable and less stressful.

With a compassionate and holistic approach, Lisa prioritizes overall health and well-being, especially for those who prefer not to or cannot use medications. Her personalized coaching programs blend nutrition, fitness and mindset strategies, empowering women to embrace menopause with confidence and joy. Lisa believes this time is not just another chapter in a woman’s life but a chance to rediscover herself  and explore new possibilities.

Energy Policy. Her expertise also includes Environmental Social and Governance frameworks. She has held roles in industry, and the public and private sectors.
